photos.file: Aesculus hippocastanum fruit in capsule in Armenia.jpg
photos.desc: An opened spiky capsule of Horse-chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum) revealing the seed inside, resting against tree bark with moss. Photographed in Vanadzor, Armenia.

photos.file: Aesculus hippocastanum flowers blooming at night, by baby-bear.org.jpg
photos.desc: Blooming flowers of Aesculus hippocastanum (horse-chestnut) under artificial street lighting at night. Photographed by creator of the Baby-Bear Club project ( baby-bear.org ).
On a horse chestnut tree (Aesculus hippocastanum), threaded rods were installed to "stabilize" the wood. Such measures of tree surgery were widespread until the 1980s.
